name: todo-dash
description: Dashboard for the daily todo skill: mainline goals with subgoal progress, prioritised tasks, proposals to accept or reject, history, briefs, drafts and the documents your tasks point at. Edits go straight into ~/todo/TODO.md as your own edits; the agent's daily run picks them up.
suggestedPrompts: Open TODO Dash and show me today's focus
Run my daily todo and refresh the brief
Help me triage the proposed items in my todo list
